description: This Java class 'DefaultSystemInfoService' provides system information gathering, monitoring, and reporting functionalities within the Thingsboard platform. It handles system metrics collection, feature availability checks, and periodic persistence of system data, supporting both monolith and clustered deployment modes.

classes.name: DefaultSystemInfoService
classes.description: A service class that collects, processes, and persists system metrics and information, supporting both monolith and clustered modes, with periodic updates and feature checks.

methods.name: onTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events to start or stop scheduled system info collection based on service partitioning.

methods.name: getSystemInfo
methods.description: Returns current system information, including metrics and mode (monolith or cluster).

methods.name: saveCurrentSystemInfo
methods.description: Triggers saving of current system info depending on deployment mode.

methods.name: getFeaturesInfo
methods.description: Returns information about enabled features like email, SMS, OAuth, 2FA, and Slack notifications.

methods.name: isEmailEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email service connection is valid.

methods.name: isTwoFaEnabled
methods.description: Checks if two-factor authentication is enabled via admin settings.

methods.name: isSlackEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Slack notifications are enabled via admin settings.

methods.name: saveCurrentClusterSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects and processes system info for cluster mode, including resource usage and notifications.

methods.name: saveCurrentMonolithSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects system metrics for monolith mode and triggers resource shortage notifications.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Persists collected telemetry data into the system.

methods.name: getSystemData
methods.description: Gathers system info data from the current service and other servers.

methods.name: createSystemInfoData
methods.description: Creates a SystemInfoData object from ServiceInfo.

methods.name: extractResourceUsage
methods.description: Extracts specific resource usage metric from SystemInfoData based on resource type.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduled executor service to stop periodic tasks.
